run_prepare_scene: run the script to prepare a scene folder by collecting poses, colors, and depth files into a single pth archive
run_resize_color_images: run the script to resize RGB color images to match the dimensions of their corresponding depth images
run_load_poses: run the script to load camera pose matrices from text files in the scene folder and stack them into a tensor
run_save_scene_archive: run the script to save intrinsic matrices, color paths, depth paths, and poses into a files.pth archive
review_prepare_scene_script: review the prepare_scene script that aggregates scene data from a folder structure with pose, color, and depth subdirectories
